title: Customer network advisory bundle and risk-scaling rubric for private deployment intake
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a reusable "advisory bundle" and a risk-scaling rubric to standardize intake, prioritization, and communications for Private/VPC/on-prem customer requests that involve networking, OS/patch upgrades, and air-gapped constraints. The bundle should be a single deliverable consumed by Solutions, Sales, and the onboarding team and include: an automated preflight probe template, a four-tier risk scaling rubric, comms templates for each risk lane, operator playbooks for typical remediation steps, and a clear dependency matrix for internal engineering work. Goal is to reduce time-to-triage, surface hidden blockers earlier, and ensure consistent SLA commitments to customers.
acceptance_criteria: Advisory bundle document published in Confluence with versioned artifacts and maintainer contact
Automated preflight probe template (curl/k8s/snippets) stored in repository and runnable by engineering or customer with clear output parsing
Four-tier risk rubric documented with decision boundaries and sample customer cases for each tier
Comms templates (high/medium/low/none) provided for CS/SE outreach and breach escalations
At least two pilot onboardings run with Solutions using the bundle and feedback captured
Dependencies and handoff checklist between PM, Solutions, Eng, Security, and Support mapped
success_metrics: Median time from intake to initial risk classification reduced from baseline by 40%
% of intakes that have complete preflight data at Triage >= 80%
Number of ad-hoc network follow-ups per intake reduced by 50%
Fewer scope-change escalations to Eng during implementation (qualitative feedback from pilot)
>90% satisfaction from Solutions team in pilot survey
comments: 2026-03-01 Aisha K: Initial scoping. Observed recurring blindspots: missing MTU/firewall rules, OS patch constraints, and lack of documented proxy certificates from customer. Propose a preflight probe that emits a compact JSON report.

2026-03-03 Martin R: Met with Solutions team. They want minimal friction for customers; preflight must run from both customer network and from our probe agent. Add a 'self-hosted probe' snippet for air-gapped sites.

2026-03-05 Daniel P: Eng input: we can produce a low-risk compatibility shim (non-invasive probe) that only tests connectivity to service endpoints on config ports. Will require short RFC for security approval.

2026-03-07 Lina M: Security flagged certificate/key handling for self-hosted probe. Require KMS integration guidance and a short runbook for secure artifact transfer. Marked security_review_required = true.
2026-03-09 Mei C: Design sprint planned to produce the single-page advisory PDF and triage UI copy for Solutions. Focus on readability and clear next-actions per risk tier.

2026-03-11 Tom O: Onboarding ran a pilot with customer ACME Corp. Preflight identified an outbound proxy requiring custom CA. Pilot notes attached to drive link; recommended update to comms template to include 'proxy CA step'.
2026-03-12 Aisha K: Updated acceptance criteria to include pilot run requirement. Next: schedule cross-functional review 2026-03-16 and finalize bundle artifacts
next_steps: Finalize preflight probe spec and PR for repo (Eng owner: Daniel)
Design one-page advisory doc and comms templates (Design owner: Mei)
Security review kickoff and threat model for self-hosted probe (Security owner: Lina)
Pilot two customers during March-April intake window and capture metrics (Solutions owner: Priya)
Ship advisory bundle v0.1 and run training for Onboarding and Sales ops
notes: We intentionally frame this as an "advisory bundle" (not gating policy) to enable rapid adoption by Solutions while preserving opt-in controls for customers. Risk rubric will be used to recommend engagement lane (self-serve, concierge, Eng-assisted) and to size SOW work for Dedicated/Private installs.
operator_guidance: For air-gapped installs: use the self-hosted probe and follow secure upload flow in the runbook
If preflight returns 'Tier 4 - Blocker', escalate to Eng + Security with probe artifact attached
